items.correct: No — carbohydrates are the body's main energy source for exercise.
items.random_wrong: Protein gives the fastest energy for exercise.
items.why: A balanced diet with enough carbohydrate fuels training and performance.

items.q: Does sweating measure how much fat you've burned?
items.correct: No — sweating regulates body temperature, not fat loss.
items.misconception: Yes, more sweat means more fat burned.
items.random_wrong: You don't need to drink water during long exercise.
items.why: Sweating cools you down; hydration is essential during prolonged exercise.
